migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Clarified the public rubric wording and evidence descriptions. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds model selection, seeded storage comparison and isolated entitlement drill receipts. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-combat, no-store. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (perWeaponP50S to perAttackP50S; maxFocusFireErrS to maxMultiAttackerErrS; focusFire to multiAttacker; ttkBandS to timeToDefeatBandS; maxLootIntervalWidth to maxRewardIntervalWidth; maxTierDays to maxProgressStepDays; tierDaysEstimate to stepDaysEstimate; minF2pShareOfPaid to minFreeShareOfPaid; freeItemsPerSeason to freeItemsPerPeriod; paidItemsPerSeason to paidItemsPerPeriod; passEdge to paidEdge; passItems to paidOfferItems; pass-paid-edge to paid-advantage; ttk to timeToDefeat; loot to randomRewards; f2p to freeVsPaid). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Resource definitions, session logs, simulated distributions and reconciliation tests from your game.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

no-combat.reason: The game has no combat; its 20 points are shared over the other lines. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-store.reason: The game sells nothing (no paid items, currency or access). Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
